name: DataTable
description: A powerful compound data table component built on TanStack Table with server-side pagination, sorting, filtering, column visibility, row selection, column reordering via drag-and-drop, and loading states. Uses the useDataTable hook for centralized state management. Designed for complex backoffice tables that require advanced interactivity — for simple static tables, use the Table component instead.

hook.name: useDataTable
hook.description: Centralized state management hook for DataTable. Manages pagination, sorting, filters, column visibility, and column order. Returns state and setter pairs that can be spread directly onto <DataTable> via {...tableState}. Optionally syncs state to URL when a router is provided.

options.name: pageSize
options.description: Initial number of rows per page.

options.name: namespace
options.description: Prefix for URL params when multiple tables share the same page. Example: 'shipments' produces ?shipments_page=1&shipments_filters=...

options.name: debounceMs
options.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds for filter changes when syncing to URL.

options.name: router
options.description: Next.js router instance. When provided, table state is synced to URL automatically.

options.name: searchParams
options.description: Next.js searchParams for reading initial state from URL.

returns.name: pagination
returns.description: Current pagination state: { pageIndex: number, pageSize: number }.

returns.name: setPagination
returns.description: Setter for pagination state. Accepts a value or updater function.

returns.name: sorting
returns.description: Current sorting state array: [{ id: string, desc: boolean }].

returns.name: columnFilters
returns.description: Current column filters array: [{ id: string, value: unknown }].

returns.name: columnVisibility
returns.description: Object mapping column IDs to boolean visibility.

returns.name: columnOrder
returns.description: Array of column IDs defining the display order.

returns.name: isPending
returns.description: True while a URL transition is pending (useful for loading indicators during navigation).

returns.name: getSearchParams
returns.description: Helper that serializes current table state into URLSearchParams for API calls.

returns.name: onPaginationChange / onSortingChange / onColumnFiltersChange / onColumnVisibilityChange / onColumnOrderChange
returns.description: Aliases for the setters above. These match DataTable prop names so {...tableState} spreads them directly onto DataTable without manual wiring.

columnDefinition.description: Array of TanStack Table column definitions. Re-exported from the design system so consumers never need @tanstack/react-table directly.

props.name: columns
props.description: Array of TanStack Table column definitions. Import ColumnDef from the design system. Each column defines header, accessorKey or accessorFn, optional cell renderer, and column-level features (enableSorting, enableHiding, size).

props.name: data
props.description: Array of row data objects. Typically fetched from an API. The data must match the shape expected by the column definitions.

props.name: pageCount
props.description: Total number of pages. Calculated as Math.ceil(totalItems / pageSize). Required because DataTable uses server-side (manual) pagination.

props.name: pagination
props.description: Controlled pagination state: { pageIndex: number, pageSize: number }. Provided by useDataTable via spread.

props.name: onPaginationChange
props.description: Pagination change handler. Provided by useDataTable via spread.

props.name: sorting
props.description: Controlled sorting state. Array of { id: string, desc: boolean }. If not provided, managed internally.

props.name: onSortingChange
props.description: Sorting change handler. Provided by useDataTable via spread.

props.name: columnFilters
props.description: Controlled column filters state. Array of { id: string, value: unknown }. If not provided, managed internally.

props.name: onColumnFiltersChange
props.description: Column filters change handler. Provided by useDataTable via spread.

props.name: rowSelection
props.description: Controlled row selection state. Object mapping row indices to boolean. Must be used together with enableRowSelection and onRowSelectionChange.

props.name: onRowSelectionChange
props.description: Row selection change handler. Manage externally with useState when you need access to selected rows.

props.name: enableRowSelection
props.description: Enables row selection. Set to true to allow all rows, or pass a function for conditional selection per row.

props.name: getRowId
props.description: Custom row ID getter. Useful for stable selection across page changes. If not provided, TanStack Table uses the row index.

props.name: columnVisibility
props.description: Controlled column visibility state. Object mapping column IDs to boolean. If not provided, managed internally.

props.name: onColumnVisibilityChange
props.description: Column visibility change handler. Provided by useDataTable via spread.

props.name: columnOrder
props.description: Controlled column order state. Array of column IDs. If not provided, managed internally.

props.name: onColumnOrderChange
props.description: Column order change handler. Provided by useDataTable via spread.

props.name: enableColumnReordering
props.description: Enables drag-and-drop column reordering via @dnd-kit. When true, DataTableColumnHeader renders a drag handle (GripVertical icon). Requires columns to use DataTableColumnHeader.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: When true, DataTableContent renders skeleton rows instead of data. Headers are still visible. Hide DataTablePagination during loading: {!isLoading && <DataTablePagination />}.

props.name: loadingRowCount
props.description: Number of skeleton rows to render when isLoading is true.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Custom empty state rendered when data array is empty and isLoading is false. Defaults to NoDataMessage component.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged with default 'space-y-4' wrapper styling.

props.name: children
props.description: Compound children. Use DataTableToolbar, DataTableContent, DataTablePagination, and DataTableViewOptions as children. If no children are provided, renders DataTableContent by default.

subComponents.name: DataTableContent
subComponents.description: Renders the table body with headers, rows, loading skeletons, and empty state. Must be placed inside <DataTable>. Automatically reads table state from internal context — no props needed.

subComponents.name: DataTableToolbar
subComponents.description: A flex container (items-center, justify-between, gap-2) for placing filter inputs, action buttons, and view options above the table. Place inside <DataTable> before <DataTableContent>.

props.name: children
props.description: Filter inputs, buttons, DataTableViewOptions, or any controls.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged with 'flex items-center justify-between gap-2'.

subComponents.name: DataTableColumnHeader
subComponents.description: Sortable column header component. Renders a ghost Button with sort direction indicators (ChevronUp/ChevronDown/ChevronsUpDown). When enableColumnReordering is active, also renders a GripVertical drag handle. Use this in the column definition's header property to enable sorting and/or drag-reordering on that column.

props.name: column
props.description: The TanStack Table column instance. Passed from the column definition's header render function: header: ({ column }) => <DataTableColumnHeader column={column} title="Name" />.

props.name: title
props.description: Display text for the column header.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: DataTableViewOptions
subComponents.description: Dropdown menu button (Settings2 icon) to toggle column visibility. Shows all columns that have enableHiding: true (or undefined) and an accessorFn. Place inside <DataTableToolbar> or as a direct child of <DataTable>. When inside <DataTable>, reads the table instance from context automatically.

props.name: table
props.description: Optional explicit table instance. When used inside <DataTable>, this is read from context and does not need to be passed.

subComponents.name: DataTablePagination
subComponents.description: Pagination controls with rows-per-page selector (Select), page indicator, and navigation buttons (first/prev/next/last). Shows selected row count when rows are selected. Place as the last child inside <DataTable>. Hide during loading state: {!isLoading && <DataTablePagination />}.

props.name: table
props.description: Optional explicit table instance. When used inside <DataTable>, this is read from context and does not need to be passed.

props.name: pageSizeOptions
props.description: Array of page size options shown in the rows-per-page selector.

props.name: showRowSelection
props.description: When true and rows are selected, shows 'X of Y row(s) selected' text. When no rows are selected, shows 'Y row(s)' instead.

accessibility.role: table (native HTML semantics via the underlying Table component)
accessibility.keyboard: Tab navigates through interactive elements (sort buttons, checkboxes, action buttons, pagination controls). Sort buttons toggle direction on Enter/Space. Drag handles support keyboard reordering via arrow keys. Pagination buttons are keyboard accessible with sr-only labels.
accessibility.aria: Row selection state conveyed via data-[state=selected] on TableRow. Checkbox columns use aria-label for screen readers. Drag handles use aria-label='Drag to reorder column'. Pagination buttons have sr-only text ('Go to first page', 'Go to previous page', etc.). Sort direction indicated visually via icons (ChevronUp for asc, ChevronDown for desc, ChevronsUpDown for unsorted).
accessibility.notes: The table renders inside a 'rounded-md border' container. Loading state preserves table headers and renders animated skeleton bars for body cells. Empty state renders a full-width NoDataMessage inside the table body — headers remain visible so users understand the page context. When enableColumnReordering is true, DndContext is only initialized after client-side hydration to prevent SSR mismatches.

examples.title: Basic DataTable with server-side pagination
examples.description: Minimal setup: define columns with ColumnDef, use useDataTable for state, fetch data in useEffect reacting to pagination changes, spread tableState onto DataTable.

examples.title: Sortable columns
examples.description: Use DataTableColumnHeader in the column definition's header property to enable click-to-sort. Include tableState.sorting in the useEffect dependencies and pass sort params to your API.

examples.title: Filtering with debounced input
examples.description: Use DataTableToolbar with an Input and useDebouncedCallback to update columnFilters. Reset pagination to page 0 when filters change. Include tableState.columnFilters in the useEffect dependencies.

examples.title: Row selection with action toolbar
examples.description: Add a checkbox column, enable row selection, and conditionally render a toolbar with bulk actions when rows are selected.

examples.title: Column visibility toggle
examples.description: Set column id (used as display name in the toggle menu) and enableHiding per column. Add DataTableViewOptions as a child of DataTable.
examples.code:
import { DataTable, DataTableContent, DataTablePagination, DataTableViewOptions, ColumnDef, useDataTable } from "@traxion-global/design-system/react";

const columns: ColumnDef<User>[] = [
  { header: "ID", accessorKey: "id", enableHiding: false, size: 50 },
  { id: "Name", header: "Name", accessorKey: "firstName" },
  { id: "Email", header: "Email", accessorKey: "email" },
];

<DataTable columns={columns} data={data} pageCount={pageCount} {...tableState}>
  <DataTableViewOptions />
  <DataTableContent />
  <DataTablePagination />
</DataTable>

examples.title: Column reordering via drag-and-drop
examples.description: Set enableColumnReordering on DataTable. Use DataTableColumnHeader on columns to render drag handles. Set enableSorting: false if the column should only be draggable, not sortable.

examples.title: Loading state
examples.description: Pass isLoading={true} to show skeleton rows. Hide pagination during loading.

examples.title: All features combined
examples.description: Comprehensive example combining row selection, sorting, filtering, column visibility, column reordering, loading state, action buttons, and mixed cell content.

do: Always use useDataTable() hook for state management and spread it onto DataTable: {...tableState}
Always include <DataTablePagination /> — every backoffice table must have pagination
Reset pagination to page 0 when filters change: useEffect(() => { tableState.setPagination(prev => ({ ...prev, pageIndex: 0 })); }, [tableState.columnFilters])
Use useDebouncedCallback for filter inputs to avoid excessive API calls while the user types
Set enableSorting: false and enableHiding: false on action and checkbox columns
Use DataTableColumnHeader for any column that should be sortable — it provides consistent sort indicators
Set a column id (e.g., id: 'Name') when using DataTableViewOptions so the toggle menu shows human-readable names instead of accessorKey paths
Include tableState.sorting and tableState.columnFilters in your useEffect dependencies when they are used
Use the cell render function with row.original to access the full row data object for custom cell content
Use mixed-content cells (multiple lines in one cell) for related data that doesn't justify its own column
Use icons from lucide-react only — never emoji, unicode, or other icon libraries
Place DataTableViewOptions inside DataTableToolbar for consistent layout
dont: Don't use DataTable for simple static tables — use the Table component instead
Don't manage pagination/sorting/filter state manually with useState — use useDataTable() hook
Don't import from @tanstack/react-table directly — import ColumnDef, Row, Column from @traxion-global/design-system/react
Don't use client-side pagination — DataTable is designed for server-side (manual) pagination only
Don't forget to pass pageCount — it is required for server-side pagination to work
Don't show DataTablePagination while isLoading is true — it will show stale data
Don't use enableColumnReordering without DataTableColumnHeader on the columns — the drag handle is rendered by DataTableColumnHeader
Don't create separate columns for closely related data (city + state + country) — use a multi-line cell instead
Don't hardcode color values — use semantic Tailwind classes (text-muted-foreground, text-destructive, etc.)
